content.en: An adult wears an external support along one arm over clothing. A shoulder harness joins an exposed rigid bracket fixed to an upper-arm cuff; an external elbow hinge links that cuff to a forearm cuff, with the human wrist visibly distinct beyond the cuff.
content.ko: 성인이 옷 바깥으로 한쪽 팔을 따라 외부 지지 구조를 착용한다. 어깨 하네스는 위팔 커프에 고정된 노출된 단단한 브래킷과 이어지고, 외부 팔꿈치 경첩이 위팔 커프와 아래팔 커프를 연결하며 사람의 손목은 커프 끝 너머에서 구분되어 보인다.
content.definition: Wearable upper-limb exoskeleton with an exposed harness-to-cuff linkage. An adult wears an external support along one arm over clothing. A shoulder harness joins an exposed rigid bracket fixed to an upper-arm cuff; an external elbow hinge links that cuff to a forearm cuff, with the human wrist visibly distinct beyond the cuff.
